history.overview: The Heart of Discord is the arcane engine of the Muramite invasion.

timeline.name: Core Excavation
timeline.description: Dragorn slaves uncovered a natural Discord fissure.

timeline.name: Anchor Installation
timeline.description: Muramite Inquisitors installed ritual anchors to stabilize the fissure.

timeline.name: Heart Awakening
timeline.description: The Heart of Discord was awakened, creating a nexus of unstable energy.

timeline.name: Manifestation Surge
timeline.description: Discord manifestations began appearing throughout the chamber.
